_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-templates-and-copy (REQ-ATC-001 and REQ-ATC-002, matrix rows age-04 and pla-14). AgendaTemplate (slug agenda-template) is a named, ordered list of agenda items a secretary starts a meeting's agenda from; each entry carries what a copied agenda item keeps (title, kind, description, duration, configured type, formality). MeetingType.defaultAgendaTemplate names the template the Agenda widget offers first for meetings of that type.

AgendaTemplate.title: Agenda template
AgendaTemplate.description: A named list of agenda items a meeting's agenda can start from.

name.title: Name
name.description: The template as the secretary picks it, such as Council meeting.

description.title: Description
description.description: What kind of meeting this template is for.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the agenda item.

itemType.title: Kind
itemType.description: Whether the item informs, is discussed or is decided.

description.title: Description
description.description: The text the agenda item starts with.

type.title: Agenda item type
type.description: The configured agenda item type, by id.

isFormality.title: Formality
isFormality.description: Whether the item is adopted without debate.

defaultAgendaTemplate.title: Default agenda template
defaultAgendaTemplate.description: The agenda template offered first for meetings of this type.
